name: Tahini (Sesame Paste)
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated on SIBO diet as it's FODMAP-free, though high fat content may slow gastric emptying.
preparationTips: Stir well before use as oil separation is natural
Store in refrigerator after opening to prevent rancidity
Thin with small amounts of water or lemon juice for easier mixing
Choose hulled tahini for milder flavor and smoother texture
nutritionalHighlights: good source of magnesium and phosphorus
